subtitles.text: Once we cross it, according to the book, there'll be no way back until we clear every trial. There are no save points inside. Only forward.
Looks like we have to go through all three. I hope at least we can go as a group. I really don't fancy getting separated from you two in there.
I'm not letting either of you out of my sight. Whatever's on the other side.
You're alive. You're alive, you idiot.
Estela? What...?
Where's Will?
Hey. I couldn't leave without saying goodbye properly.
Take care of your brother. Take care of him for me too. And take care of each other.
Thank you, for being my family, even if only for a little while.

Before he destroyed the Path, he used the forbidden spell of resurrection.
That's why you're alive. That's why... he's gone.
Will, what are you doing? Get out of there!
Will! Use your magic, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat the demon!
How interesting!
The demon's attack has awakened your magic.
Will! Use it against the demon, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat him.
Will, watch out!
Take that!
What... what was that?
Will, get out of the way!
That's it, Will! You've got this!
Come on, boy! I know you can do it!
Don't give up! Finish it once and for all!
Look at the rune ring! You can only hurt him while it glows: attack then!
Not like that! Hit him while the ring isn't glowing and he heals. Wait for it to light up!
He drops orbs when you hit him! Orange ones heal you, blue ones restore your magic. Grab them!
This way, Will!
That's for being ugly.
Oh, didn't see that coming?
Poor little thing.
You're sooo boring...

Oh nooo, please... someone help me!
...these two big strong muscular warriors...
...are going to rob a helpless little princess like me...
...Was that it?
Piece of cake!
That fool is going to ruin my plans...
So… that's the pure-hearted boy who will open the Path.
I'm glad that demon managed to awaken his magic.
Ha… ha ha…
Let's see if this golem is enough...
If not... I'll have to step in myself.
Nobody interrupts me while I'm eating!
RUUUUUN!!!

The first time I cast a spell, I nearly singed my own eyebrows off.
And look at me now... an actual prodigy.
Fear isn't the problem, kiddo.
The problem would be if you stopped trying. And I'm not letting that happen.
Will... what's wrong?

You won't be facing this alone.
Whatever happens.

It's the first time I've ever left home.
My whole life has been back there.
I'm scared, Liam. What if I can't control this?
What if out there, what I am just isn't enough... and it all goes wrong?
...Thank you. Okay. Let's go.
Run! Flee from Estela until her anger blows over!

We need to find out what's behind that demon appearing, and now a golem too...
And why they're after you.
I think I've lost my appetite.
Yes, yes, very insightful. And when is the food coming?
That... wasn't me.
FINALLY!
NOBODY interrupts me when I'm eating!
This guy's going to get it!

Pardon the interruption...
My name is Liam, and I couldn't help overhearing your conversation.
I think I have information that might interest you.
And what it has to do with my magic...
Estela... do you really eat like that?
WHAT?!
Spiders, attack!
Piece of cake? Let's see if our technique is that easy to handle...
Little princess? More like little ugly, don't you think?
Hand over everything you've got and we won't hurt you.
Good grief...
Take care of my brother.

Why do you think you're alive, boy?
Have you never wondered why you remember nothing of yourself, or your past?
I'll tell you why — you remember nothing of yourself, your family, or your village,
because eons ago you died fighting me.
You died that day. You are the reincarnation of the only mage who ever managed to stop me!
You forced me to unleash my ultimate spell of destruction, but back then I couldn't control it.
When it all slipped beyond my grasp, I bound my soul to the Path,
waiting for the day some other fool would clear its trials
and wish me back to life.
To keep the spell from touching your family and your pitiful village,
you poured every last drop of magic inside you into a protective spell —
one that saved your people, but destroyed you.
What I don't understand is how, after dying, you're still here…

Are they still arguing? They’ve been at it for a while...
Before we go and see what’s happening, I wanted to show you something.
Let’s go see what’s going on.
Let's go.
I’ve learned a new spell. Watch.
Wait a moment... I need to catch my breath.
Will! Wait up!
Okay, I like this a lot better.
Here. So you don't forget where you come from.
That's... surprisingly thoughtful.
We should do this more often. Once all this is over, I mean.
Minus the haunted forests. And the candy castles.
No golems, no demons, no—
That's—

It's too much like mine. Like my maze.
I don't think I can go in there, Liam. I'm sorry.
You don't have to be sorry. This trial is mine. It makes sense I face it alone.

Then I'm not going in either. If Will stays, I stay with him. I'm not leaving him out here alone.
But that doesn't mean we're leaving you alone either, understood? We'll be right here, waiting, when you come out.
Thank you. Both of you.
What was the true price you paid to get this far, Mage?
Here... here it is.
Open it. We've come this far.
The ritual to open the Path of the Stars...
Wait. There's more. Two spells noted in the margin, in a different hand... older.

The Time Spell. And... the Resurrection Spell.
Forbidden. There's a note in the margin explaining why.
Whatever that note says... I think we should save this for when we truly need it.
From here on, there's no turning back, is there?
There wasn't from the start. But now... now we truly know it.
Wow, this is actually terrifying.
Don't laugh, it's horrible. I hate speaking in front of people.
A clumsy speech never killed anyone... though I'll admit this one was particularly bad.
It's only an echo. We're right here. Look at us.
I don't deserve you coming to find me. I hurt my own friend.
And Liam? After what he did...
Let's go find him, then. Before this place swallows him whole.
Just so we're clear: this doesn't mean everything's forgiven. It just means I'm not letting him die over feeling guilty.
After what I did...

It was an accident. And I didn't come to judge you.
I came because no one gets left behind. Not even when they mess up.
If we don't forgive him, we're no better than the man who pushed him to do it.
Get up. We're not done yet.
After what you did — and everything you've done since then to try to fix it. That counts too.
Tell me it isn't true. Tell me what we just saw isn't what it looks like.

You planned all of it. The demon in the woods.
The danger. You used Will as bait from day one.
Don't you dare use that as an excuse!
Will... I'm sorry...
My brother is dying. I was desperate. I thought if I could reach the Path...
I don't deserve to be followed.
Both of you, please, stop!

Forbidden Spell: Temporal Regression!
Turn back time... and this time, dodge it.

Your magic, in the moment of your death,
searched through time and space
for a vessel to hold your soul.
Your wish to protect your people, your family,
to end that man's tyranny,
led you to a sick boy
whose heart had just stopped beating,
right as your soul arrived.

You must end the Path.
There is no other way to stop mages like him
from using this place for their own gain, ever again.

You must protect them.
Them, and all of humanity that comes after.
Only then will you truly prove, once and for all, who you really are.

No, Will. You are here, and there.
You are wherever you want to be.
This is only your power, your magic,
the fruit of the good you have done throughout your life.
It's all right, Estela. Don't worry... I've got it all figured out.
Take care of each other. I've already made it home.
Heal his brother. That's the only thing I ask.

Now... now I remember it all.
The protective spell. My parents. My village…
But what am I doing here? How is this possible? And in this body…
You haven’t changed a bit! What are Eldran and Victoria arguing about? I can hear them from here.
Have I gotten my memory back… and I'm dead?
Then I…
Destroy the Path… What about Estela? And Liam?
Where am I?
That’s it. Let them hear you from the bridge.
You got it!
Thanks, master! I couldn't have righted it on my own.
Go. I’ll handle him.
I don’t know. Get them to the bridge, quickly.
And when you get back, no more errands. You need a rest.
Come back soon.
Who is he? What does he want?
And you?
As long as I stand, you won’t reach them.
Do you think you can save them all on your own?
You can’t even save yourself.
Everyone, to the bridge! Quickly, don’t look back!
Master! My cart’s tipped over again. And I was going slowly this time.
Master! The balloon is stuck at the top of the bell tower.
Whoa, it’s flying!
Look at it go!
It’s going to reach the clouds!
All of them!
If anyone can hear me, give me the strength to protect the valley. I want to get back to Liora.
Protect them...!
To the bridge! All of you, now!
Kneel. You have one hour to leave the valley. Resist, and I’ll raze it all.
Carefully... That’s it.
Whoops! I went too far. Sorry, everyone.
Good morning, valley. What needs fixing today?
I meant to answer today. But something always comes up in the valley.
Have you decided what to tell the academy? You’ve had that letter for weeks.
You don’t have to stay just because they need you here. What do you want?
I told you the pears should go on top.
And I told you there wasn’t another crate. Look, they’re fine.
Well, they’re still intact. Maybe you were right.
See? Nothing to worry about. Go say hello to Will; he’s been waiting a while.
Will! Sorry about the fuss. You know what we’re like when it comes to packing fruit.
I left a crate of apples under a tree in the forest. Could you go and get it?
It’s at the foot of an ash tree, beside the path.
Victoria, careful! Put the apples on top and you’ll bruise the pears.
There isn’t another crate, Eldran. This way, it all fits.
Then put the pears on top, like we always do.
Arguing over crates again... I’d better see what’s going on.
Need a hand with the crates?
Yes, please. Help me stack them before you two go.
